2:231.text: And when you divorce women and they have
fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or release them according to acceptable terms, and do not keep them, intending harm, to transgress
. And whoever does that has certainly wronged himself. And do not take the verses of Allāh in jest. And remember the favor of Allāh upon you and what has been revealed to you of the Book
by which He instructs you. And fear Allāh and know that Allāh is Knowing of all things.
